answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing cryptographic proof-of-compute linked to verifiable economic stake, ensuring every digital mirror of an identity requires proportional resource expenditure. As an attacker attempts to spawn fake agents, the marginal cost to generate a valid validation signal escalates exponentially. This creates an economic spiral that rapidly bankrupts malicious actors, effectively pricing out unauthorized identity replication while preserving genuine agent interoperability.
